title: aloysia ligustrina var. paraguariensis
intro: Aloysia ligustrina var. paraguariensis, commonly known as Yerba Buena, is a plant species that belongs to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, respiratory problems, and as an anti-inflammatory agent due to its health benefits, which include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Yerba Buena include relaxing the muscles, reducing stress and anxiety, and soothing respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Yerba Buena include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
